title: score-dev.ts: match a label to an analyzer symbol by declaration site, not qualname (DEC-303 (a93) item 4)
description: DEC-303 (a93) item 4, Q-B A made exact: score-dev.ts matches an analyzer symbol to a label by DECLARATION SITE (file plus the def's line and column), never by a loosened, suffix or fuzzy qualname. The analyzer and its shipped output are untouched. Controls: re-scoring the same rich labels at dev 0e72f09 flips exactly 22.0 and nothing else (61/66 instead of 60/66); a fixture with two same-named nested classes at different declaration sites is refused for the wrong one. Pre-read done for the ruling's before-building step: at rich pin 3a109ccd the real lexical nesting of RichFormatter is install (rich/pretty.py:155) -> display_hook (184) -> class RichFormatter (214, col 9); the census qualname install.display_hook.RichFormatter states that real nesting, and the analyzer emits install.RichFormatter, dropping display_hook, so a separate ordinary naming follow-up is filed, no hold. Lands before the pre-registration; two rounds.

acceptanceCriteria.text: score-dev.ts resolves each label target to an analyzer symbol by declaration site (file, def line and column) and never by qualname equality, suffix or fuzzy match
Re-scoring the rich labels at dev 0e72f09 reports 61/66 with exactly 22.0 flipped and no other site changed
A fixture with two same-named nested classes at different declaration sites is refused when the edge points at the wrong one
The analyzer and its shipped output are unchanged by the change
